title: Coursework credits (master's)
key: At least 24 credits; thesis research counts up to 6
rule: Earn at least 24 credits.
Thesis research (대학원 논문연구) is recognised up to 6 credits.
It can be taken again within that limit, but you cannot take 2 or more thesis research courses in one semester.
source_quote_ko: □ 이수학점: 24학점 이상
quotes_ko: □ 이수학점: 24학점 이상

key: At least 60 credits; thesis research counts up to 18

title: Grade point average
key: 3.0 or higher, over all courses and over major courses
rule: The grade point average of all your courses and the grade point average of your major courses (전공 평점) must be 3.0 or higher.

title: Recognition as a PhD student (integrated)
key: From the 4th semester, after 3 semesters and 24 credits
rule: A student who has completed 3 or more semesters and earned 24 or more credits is recognised as a PhD student from the 4th semester.
Certificates about your student record are then issued as 'enrolled in the PhD program'.
source_quote_ko: ○ 3개 학기 이상을 이수하고, 24학점 이상을 취득한 학생은 4학기 때부터 박사과정으로 인정하며, 학적 관련 제 증명 등을 발급할 때는 박사과정 재학 중으로 발급됨

title: Graduate courses taken during an SNU bachelor's degree
key: Up to 6 credits can be carried over, on application
rule: On application, up to 6 credits are recognised (학-석사간 교과 학점 통산 인정).
Only graduate courses of the same or a similar major, taken in an SNU bachelor's program beyond the credits needed to graduate, with a grade of B0 or higher.
The recognised credits count as earned credits but are not included in the grade point average.
source_quote_ko: ○ 학-석사간 교과 학점 통산 인정 신청: 최대 6학점까지 인정
quotes_ko: ○ 학-석사간 교과 학점 통산 인정 신청: 최대 6학점까지 인정
- 본교 학사과정에서 졸업학점을 초과하여 이수한 동일·유사전공 대학원 과목 중 성적이 B0 이상인 과목에 한하여 신청 가능
- 통산 인정 학점은 이수 학점에는 포함되나 평점 평균에는 포함되지 않음

title: Graduate courses taken during an SNU master's degree
key: Up to 12 credits can be carried over, on application
rule: On application, up to 12 credits are recognised (석-박사과정 간 교과 학점 통산 인정).
Only graduate courses of the same or a similar major, taken in an SNU master's program beyond the credits required for completion, with a grade of B0 or higher.
The recognised credits count as earned credits but are not included in the grade point average.
source_quote_ko: ○ 석-박사과정 간 교과 학점 통산 인정 신청: 최대 12학점까지 인정

title: Undergraduate courses
key: Up to 6 credits in total, with your advisor's approval
rule: Undergraduate courses approved by your advisor count as completion credits up to 6 credits, counted over the master's and PhD programs together.
They are recognised as other-major credits (타전공 인정); submit the form 학부과목 이수 승인신청서.
Only courses of the same or a similar major count. General and liberal-education courses (일반·교양과목) are excluded.
source_quote_ko: ○ 대학원 과정의 학생이 학사과정 교과목을 이수하고자 할 경우, 지도교수의 승인을 받은 학부 교과목은 석사, 박사 통산 6학점까지 수료학점으로 인정

title: Courses of other departments (master's)
key: At most half of the credits left after thesis research
rule: Graduate courses of other departments of the College of Engineering and the College of Natural Sciences, recommended by your advisor and recognised by the department head, can count as major courses and as completion credits, within 1/2 of the completion credits of your program.
In principle the 1/2 is taken after thesis research credits are removed: (completion credits − thesis research credits actually taken) × 1/2.
Submit the form 타학과과목 이수 승인신청서.

title: Smart Ocean Mobility interdisciplinary major courses (융합전공)
key: S/U-graded M3507. courses may not count toward completion
rule: Courses opened for this interdisciplinary major with the code 414. or M1513. count as credits of your own major (원전공), whether or not you have entered the interdisciplinary major.
Courses with the code M3507. that are graded A/F also count as own-major credits.
For a student who has entered the interdisciplinary major, M3507. courses graded S/U count as completion credits of the interdisciplinary major.
For a student of this department who has not entered it, or who entered and gave it up, M3507. courses graded S/U are not own-major credits and are not included in completion credits.

That exclusion applies from those entering in the 2nd semester of 2023 (2023년 2학기 진입생). A student who took such a course in the 1st semester of 2023 or earlier gets other-major credit for it, included in completion credits.
source_quote_ko: ○ 스마트오션모빌리티 융합전공 교과목 관련 수료학점 인정여부
quotes_ko: ○ 스마트오션모빌리티 융합전공 교과목 관련 수료학점 인정여부
과목코드: 414. 또는 M1513. - 일반과정 기준 원전공 학점으로 인정
과목코드: M3507. - A/F 학점으로 분류되는 과목: 일반과정기준 원전공 학점으로 인정 - S/U 학점으로 분류되는 과목: 융합전공 수료 학점으로 인정
- S/U 학점으로 분류되는 과목: (조선해양공학과) 일반과정 기준 원전공 학점으로 인정하지 않으며, 수료학점 미포함***

*** 융합전공에 진입하지 않거나 진입 후 중도 포기한 조선해양공학과 학생의 경우 M3507. 교과목 중 S/U학점 분류 과목에 대한 원전공 학점 미인정은 2023년 2학기 진입생부터 적용하며, 2023년 1학기 혹은 그 이전에 M3507. 교과목 중 S/U학점 분류 교과목을 수강한 학생은 융합전공 진입하지 않았거나 중도 포기한 경우에도 타전공 학점으로 인정(수료학점 포함).

key: Count toward completion up to 3 credits; not in the major average
rule: Credits from the College of Engineering's common competency courses (공통역량과목) are included in completion credits, up to 3 credits.
They are not reflected in the major grade point average.
They are recognised as other-major courses (타전공 인정); submit the form 타학과과목 이수 승인신청서.

title: Journal paper or conference presentation (master's)
key: A thesis-related paper or an international oral presentation
rule: By the day the result of your master's thesis examination is reported, meet at least one of the two conditions below.

Condition 1: a paper related to your thesis, as first author or corresponding author, published in a KCI-listed Korean journal or an SCIE/SCOPUS-listed international journal; or documents proving that it will be published, submitted to the department office.
Condition 2: an oral presentation, as first author or corresponding author, of a paper related to your thesis at an international conference.
For condition 2 the conference must have presenters from 4 or more countries and 20 or more oral presentations in total, and the 3 examiners must recognise it as an international conference.

title: Journal papers for the doctoral thesis examination
key: 2 SCIE papers, or 1 paper in a top 25% (Q1) journal
rule: To have your doctoral thesis examined, meet at least one of the two conditions below while enrolled in the SNU graduate school.
Condition 1: 2 or more papers, as first author or corresponding author, in internationally recognised journals that belong to SCIE.
Condition 2: 1 or more papers, as first author or corresponding author, in an international journal in the top 25% (Q1) of the SJR or JCR classification you choose.
Under either condition the paper is published, or documents proving that it will be published are submitted to the department office by the day of the final examination (종심일).
For Q1 you may choose whether the ranking is judged at the time the paper was submitted or at the time it was accepted.

title: Public presentation and thesis grade (master's)
key: Presentation 2.5 of 5; thesis grade B; oral examination 60
rule: The public presentation of the thesis is held in June or December.
Before the day of the presentation submit 3 copies of the preliminary review form (석사학위 논문 사전 심사서), 1 research activity sheet (연구활동표) and 1 copy of the presentation material.
The public presentation is passed with an examiners' score of 2.5 or higher out of 5.
The thesis grade must be B or higher and the oral examination 60 or higher to pass.
You must also pass every other step set by the examination committee appointed by the dean of the college or graduate school (대학(원)장).

rule: Hold a thesis presentation at least 1 time, and have the preliminary thesis examination at least 2 times.

title: Time limit for submitting the thesis (master's)
key: Within 4 years of completing coursework
rule: Submit the thesis within 4 years after completing the coursework of the program (과정 수료).
Periods of military service and of pregnancy, childbirth or childcare are not counted.
If you apply for an extension, the dean of your college or graduate school (대학(원)장) can approve up to 2 more years after review by the graduate academic affairs committee (대학원 학사 위원회).
